name: Souchun
quote: Gaze at the morning clouds and hear the evening breeze.

voices.label: Good Morning
voices.text:
A beautiful, leisurely morning begins with a cup of mild and refreshing Dragon Well tea.
Good morning, Professor.

voices.label: Good Afternoon
voices.text: Sunshine in the afternoon makes me so drowsy. Even the tea tree branches are a bit droopy.

voices.label: Good Evening
voices.text: I love the gentle night breeze and air with just the right level of humidity.

voices.label: Good Night
voices.text: Still working so late at night? I've made some green bean pastries. Would you like to try, Professor?

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 1
voices.text: The Oasis has the perfect conditions for cultivating new tea. Many aspects of life may be automated and controllable these days, but growing and harvesting tea leaves are still handiwork that requires patience and good technique.

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 2
voices.text: Fragrant leaves, tender buds. In the company of the moon at night, alone with the rosy haze at dawn.

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 3
voices.text: You're still like an old granny... haha.

voices.label: Home Screen 5
voices.text: Hello, Professor. I've prepared some afternoon tea and home-made snacks in the arboretum. Would you like to join me?

voices.label: Interactive Voice 1
voices.text: Huh? You'd like to check out my latest cultivation? It does smell very nice.

voices.label: Interactive Voice 2
voices.text: I'm in the middle of work. You're bothering me.

voices.label: Interactive Voice 3
voices.text:
Don't touch it! Watch out for the thorns...
Oh dear, now you're bleeding. Look at you. Let me wrap that up for you.

voices.label: On Duty
voices.text: Got work again? Drink this cup of Dragon Well first, it will invigorate you.

voices.label: Obtain
voices.text: Souchun reporting for duty! Let's appreciate the charm of tea together!

voices.label: Potential Breakthrough
voices.text: I'm now better at my craft.

voices.label: Neural Expansion
voices.text: Never stop growing.

voices.label: Max Rank
voices.text: All our effort will bear fruit in the end.

voices.label: Join Team
voices.text: Souchun, ready for action.

voices.label: Battle Start
voices.text: Please stand behind my shield!

voices.label: Ultimate Skill
voices.text: Grow! Spread!

voices.label: MVP 1
voices.text: I can still do better.

voices.label: MVP 2
voices.text: My research has paid off.

voices.label: Defeat
voices.text: Sorry...

voices.label: Oath
voices.text:
An oath? Professor, are you serious?
Then allow me to answer your solemn question with equal sincerity.
... I don't know when it started, but since a while ago, I've been looking forward to seeing your familiar figure. Every afternoon we spend together is a treasured piece of memory. Thanks to this daily sense of anticipation, even the dullest research becomes interesting.
So from now on, please stay by my side. I will brew as much Dragon Well tea as you'd like.

voices.label: New Year
voices.text:
Happy New Year! I wish you good health and prosperity in the coming year!
Huh? Is that a bit cheesy? But that's how we give each other blessings in my home country.
It has been another year before I knew it. So many things have happened. Anyway, I hope we'll have another great year together!

voices.label: Valentine's Day
voices.text:
Hi, Professor... Here's some matcha chocolate made with my newest batch of tea. Please accept it.
Oh! It's just a gift to express my gratitude in general. It has nothing to do with today's date. Think about it, we didn't even use to celebrate this festival in my home country, ahahaha.

voices.label: Tanabata
voices.text:
Altair, the unreachable Cowherd, and Vega, the beautiful Weaver Girl, finally get to meet today...
Spending this festival with you makes me... very happy.

voices.label: Halloween
voices.text:
Halloween? Oh, no wonder those children just came making a huge ruckus.
Pumpkin heads or vampires don't really make me feel anything, but something known as a "Jiangshi" freaks me out. Have you heard of it before? It's like a corpse in traditional garb with a paper talisman stuck on its forehead. It hops out of its coffin in the middle of the night...
Ugh! Just thinking about it is giving me the creeps...

voices.label: Christmas
voices.text:
In my hometown, some people would give apples to their crush at Christmas, while others would party outside with their friends all night. I don't really like noisy places, so I'll go with...
Ahem, would you like this apple?

voices.label: Birthday Wish
voices.text: May you live as long as the heavens. We wish you happiness on your day of birth! This is a birthday present I've made specially for you, Professor. It contains some very delicious traditional pastries. I hope they're to your liking.

voices.label: Neural Cloud
voices.text: Neural Cloud

voices.label: Intimacy 1
voices.text:
After being smoke-dried over a pinewood fire, these black tea leaves give off a very strong aroma of harvest-season fruits when steeped in water.
Adding a dash of milk will not dilute the aroma. In fact, it will turn this beverage into a textured and flavorful milk tea.
But you should only drink one cup per day if you put sugar. Any more than that and you'll gain weight. So be careful, Professor.

voices.label: Intimacy 2
voices.text:
Why am I so into tea leaves...? Actually, before joining Project Neural Cloud, I used to be the assistant of a "tea doctor"...
Oh, you probably don't understand the inside-joke. "Tea doctor" isn't a scholar with a degree in the study of tea. It's a slang for a waiter working in a teahouse, hahaha.
Anyway, as I helped him organize his botanical research notes and record data, it all slowly grew on me.

voices.label: Intimacy 3
voices.text:
The color green symbolizes life. Just being surrounded by green plants every day greatly improves your mood.
I hope the vigor and exuberance of this place can sweep away your exhaustion and fill you with energy.
Please come here often when you have free time. I'll be waiting with the very best tea leaves and snacks.

voices.label: Intimacy 4
voices.text:
Other than you, very few people appreciate my old-fashioned pastries. I learned to make them from an elderly woman, who was like family to me.
As times change and all kinds of new, trendy things emerge relentlessly one after the other, many old things are also slowly forgotten, until they disappear from history altogether.
However, I want to preserve them because these things are the embodiment of millennia of sentimentality.
I'm very glad that you acknowledge this sentiment.

voices.label: Intimacy 5
voices.text:
Look, Professor, these are new tea leaves that I have been carefully cultivating. I customized them to your personal taste, so I think you'll like it!
Huh? How do I know what you like? Well, you're a regular here and I observe your reaction every time I serve you tea.
... Oh, please don't misunderstand! It's research! Research!

voices.label: Dissatisfied
voices.text: Ugh…

voices.label: Laugh
voices.text: Hehehe.

career:
Botanist 10Pro, a biologist Doll created by 42Lab for a private lab, whose original purpose was to help with data processing in research programs.

Professor Lu Xiulan, who knew very little about Dolls, was blown away by the doll's lab capabilities and professional expertise after receiving Souchun. She swiftly arranged for Souchun to assist her with other programs.

After witnessing Souchun's numerous achievements in biology and her exceptional progress in tea research in 2058, 42Lab reached an agreement with Professor Lu Xiulan to lend Souchun in Project Neural Cloud.
infoStories:
Souchun, like the plants she cultivates, radiates the warmth of sunlight and springtime. No matter how impatient one is, the instant they speak with Souchun, they are unconsciously soothed by her tenderness.

Professor Lu Xiulan adores Souchun's personality. She even called 42Lab to see if Souchun's profile had been set up in this manner, to which she received a surprising yet pleasant reply.

"No, Souchun is not a tea-specialist researcher Doll. In fact, she was created to be well-versed in all aspects of biology."
"It was entirely coincidental that her main subject is tea. When I initially awoke her, I thought, this Doll sure looked like a human. I was unfamiliar with Dolls since I'm not one of the people under the engineering and mathematical specializations."
"When she began telling me about her features, she appeared soft and sophisticated, like a certain kind of camellia."
"It wasn't until later that I realized she was more than just a powerful computer. She is knowledgeable in a wide range of subjects. My curiosity was immediately piqued, so I decided to include her in my tea research, which is a comprehensive study."
"Yeah, that decision contributed to her later success. Truly impressive!"
—Interview excerpt with Professor Lu Xiulan

Professor Lu Xiulan organized a team-building event for the entire lab after wrapping up a large program. It was on that journey that Souchun saw a real tea garden for the first time. Knowing the art of tea by heart, she fell in love with this place right away and even applied to Professor Lu Xiulan for leave to live there for a period of time.

Souchun worked there as a tea planter for a long time, becoming involved in every step of tea production, including planting, harvesting, and processing. Later, Professor Lu Xiulan relocated her team there and aided Souchun in constructing a new tea research lab to tackle the task.

Souchun lived up to the professor's high expectations. Under her direction, a bio garden centered on tea planting gradually took shape, even contributing to the economic development of the area. It even became the center for tea research in the area.

Souchun discovered various recipes for traditional tea desserts from the locals while living as a tea planter. She adored the old-fashioned treats as much as she adored the tea, both of which symbolized humanity's long history and rich culture.

She spent a lot of her leisure time baking various tea pastries and gifting them to the locals along with newly cultured tea leaves, earning her rave reviews every time.

Traditional items such as tea's ceremony and snacks associated with such were beginning to perish from the world as a result of the cultural impact of new generations, but Souchun wishes to retain them before they become truly obsolete.

Souchun, despite being a research Doll, focused on more literary studies such as tea history, culture, and literature.

Despite having a great amount of knowledge and images stored in her database, Souchun wants to re-learn all of her favorite things through books and experience.

Souchun also intends to collaborate with Cyber Media's entertainment Dolls to rebrand traditional culture in a contemporary way, so that more people can appreciate the rich heritage of tea.

Souchun established a tea estate in the Oasis with the assistance of Sakuya. Due to limited operands and difficulties in data retrieval, the tea estate only has a few tea varieties to offer. However, she believes that if she works hard enough, she will be able to rebuild the sea of tea plants in the cloud.

Souchun is a bit concerned about being unable to leave Magrasea. But she decided to put her worries aside. Like plants, she can quickly adapt to her surroundings. In comparison to futile fretting, she might as well start doing something she can control, like experimenting with tea brews based on the tastes of the Professor and other Dolls.
oathDesc: The refreshing and elegant fragrance of tea.

projections.name: Botanist
projections.desc:
Attire produced with Neural Cloud Projection upon a Doll's arrival in Magrasea. These are the clothes they are most comfortable in.
"I envy not the exquisite earthenware glazed with gold and jade. My only wish is to boil a fine tea for a true tea lover."

"I envy not the exquisite earthenware glazed with gold and jade. My only wish is to boil a fine tea for a true tea lover."

projections.name: Tea-colored Beauty
projections.desc:
Attire and environment produced with Neural Cloud Projection upon a Doll's arrival in Magrasea, which mirrors their life in the real world.
"To enjoy the cleansing rain on a clear day, and a fine tea that resembles a fair lady."

skinList.name: Aquatic Fragrance
skinList.desc:
[Ocean Dancer Series]
"You look so much like a flower. Have you perhaps seen one of your kind that resembles a tea leaf too?" —The jellyfishes didn't answer and scurried away.

skinList.name: Wishing Projection
skinList.desc:
Warming fireworks fill the silent night, and as the embers fall, they transform into countless candleflames. This is the most beautiful scene that the Dolls left behind on a Qixi summer night.
"Although it's not as proper as a piece of needlework, this is the cat's cradle we made together, so make sure you remember it, Professor."

skinList.name: Auburn Enchantment
skinList.desc:
Stelliferous Ensemble—Listen with your soul. That concerto from between the streams of our vast galaxy is the music that carries feelings across the distant void.
"The autumn air is cool and bracing, the wind is silent, the skies are clear, and the geese fly at the edge of the horizon... Speaking of which, the only way to truly understand the richness of a song is to listen to it with your own ears."

skinList.name: Shadow of the Ruins
skinList.desc: Surging morale in a vicious battle keeps each and every Doll fighting until their final moments—whether on the offensive or defensive, at advantage or disadvantage. Memories, replicated in Magrasea with Neural Projection—""B-10, encountering ambush by unknown individuals! Don't worry, I shall hold the line and defend our teahouse!""
